title: FreshnessPolicy
description: Declarative rules for how Backpack items age, when they must be re-verified, when they are replaced in place, and how renderers should treat them. Captures the rules currently expressed in prose inside backpack-freshness-guide.

bands.description: Ordered freshness bands from freshest to stalest. Each band defines an age window and how renderers should treat items within it.

verify_after_days.description: If an item is older than this and being used to inform action, the system should re-verify before acting on specifics. Currently 7 in practice.

require_dated_entries.description: Every Backpack item must have an explicit YYYY-MM-DD date in either the key or the first line of the value.

update_in_place.description: When session work makes an entry stale, update it in place rather than appending new versions.

patterns_age_slower_than_tactics.description: Cultural and pattern context aged slower than tactical details (ticket statuses, PR states, ownership).

promote_to_doctrine_after_days.description: Optional. If a Backpack item survives this many days unchanged, consider promoting it to Doctrine.

demote_to_hoard_after_days.description: Optional. If a Backpack item ages past this without being touched, archive it to Hoard.

ttl_presets.description: Named TTLs in seconds, used by ingestion to choose sane defaults.

pinned_keys.description: Default pinned keys mirroring _config:pinned_keys, for use when a fresh Backpack is initialized.

max_age_days.description: Upper bound of this band in days from the entry's dated timestamp. Use a very large value (e.g. 36500) for evergreen.

treatment.description: How renderers and consumers should treat items in this band.

renderer_priority.description: Default surfacing priority for items in this band.
